SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Nellore. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory and dispatch it fitted — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — to the Krishnapatnam port belt, the Naidupeta industrial side and project sites across the district. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Container Office Supplier for the Nellore Port Belt range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands — no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. In a port and logistics district like Nellore, that lets a warehouse or a contractor set up a dispatch-yard office, an admin room or a gate cabin without holding up the work.

Who buys a container office in Nellore

Nellore has grown around the Krishnapatnam port and a spread of industrial and logistics units. Most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Port-logistics and warehousing units needing a dispatch-yard or admin office
  • Industrial-park and Naidupeta-side units needing a supervisor or stores cabin
  • EPC and civil contractors needing a temporary site office for a project
  • Yards needing a gate and security office at the entrance

Every unit we supply is an administrative, dispatch or gate cabin — a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as bonded, hazardous-cargo, marine-rated or port-operations structures.

Where we deliver in and around Nellore

We supply container offices across the main working pockets of the Nellore district:

  • Krishnapatnam port belt and Muthukur side — 524344
  • Nellore city and district industrial areas — 524001
  • Naidupeta industrial side — 524126
  • Kodavaluru and nearby project sites — served on enquiry

This district runs on port logistics, warehousing and light industry — buyers who often need a clean office added quickly beside a working yard. Because port-side plots need planned access, share your exact location and gate details, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Nellore site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point — a 10 ft cabin
  • A dispatch-yard, admin or supervisor office — a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area — a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A packing or dispatch yard needing storage too — a storage container office for port dispatch yards

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftDispatch-yard, admin or supervisor officeMost common for logistics use
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation, since we build to order rather than from stock.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Nellore is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin through the coastal summer
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your site works. Common additions for Nellore sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Bangalore factory

Nellore is served from our Bangalore factory on South-zone dispatch. The road route runs via Chittoor and the Tirupati corridor into Nellore and the Krishnapatnam side — roughly 360–430 km depending on your plot. Transit is typically within our standard 3–5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched; for port-side sites with heavy offloading we suggest planning 4–5 days. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the coastal corridor See container offices we run to Tirupati sites, container offices we deliver into the Sri City corridor, and container offices we route down to Chennai.

Documentation and access for port-side sites

Port and logistics units and their contractors need clean paperwork and planned access. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 29ABBCS7101B1ZR) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration, and plan the gate access and crane offloading before the unit leaves our yard. This keeps procurement, access and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Nellore

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Nellore. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote — no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Nellore?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Nellore site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to Krishnapatnam port-side sites?

Yes. We dispatch from our Bangalore factory via the Tirupati corridor to the Krishnapatnam port belt (524344), Nellore city (524001) and the Naidupeta side (524126) — about 360–430 km. Because port plots need planned access, we confirm the gate pass and offloading with your quote.

Which size suits a port logistics or warehouse admin office?

A 20 ft cabin covers most dispatch-yard, admin and supervisor needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and e-way bill for vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.

Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 to discuss your container office in Nellore, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
